win.cameraPreview.deniedMessage: Camera access is turned off in Windows privacy settings.
win.cameraPreview.unavailableMessage: The camera could not start. Try opening it again.
win.cameraPreview.notGranted: Not granted. Turn on “Camera access” and “Let desktop apps access your camera” in Windows Settings.
win.cameraPreview.privacyCaption: The camera runs only while the preview is open, and nothing is saved or sent anywhere.
win.cameraPreview.dismissCaption: Press Esc, click anywhere else or switch to another app. The camera light turns off at once.
